prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED DARK MAGENTA flat color field — think #9B1B6A,
the color of taboo, danger, and costly semantic boundary on a semantic
map. The hue must read as DARK MAGENTA, not red lineage, not violet
silence, not brown crags. Clearly distinct from all physical terrain
tiles. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one dark-
magenta color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO
vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO ridges, NO figures,
NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same
magenta hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink-and-watercolor game-map terrain tile rendered as a single saturated dark-magenta color wash filling the entire square frame edge-to-edge, corner-to-corner, with only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same deep magenta hue.

subjects.description: Flat saturated dark magenta wash covering the full 1024x1024 tile surface, uniform hue with barely perceptible brushstroke texture variation within the same magenta register
Extremely subtle watercolor granulation within the magenta field, same hue throughout, no contrast shift, no secondary color, pure surface variation only
